mapper.select: select distinct b.billing_category from proj_category_billing b where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '0' order by b.billing_category
mapper.insert: insert into proj_category_billing( category_id, billing_type, billing_category, unit_price, price_unit, min_quantity, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time )values( #{categoryId}, #{billingType}, #{billingCategory}, #{unitPrice}, #{priceUnit}, #{minQuantity}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.update: update proj_category_billing set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select b.billing_category as "name", min(coalesce(b.sort_order, 9999)) as "sortOrder" from proj_category_billing b where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '0' group by b.billing_category
